data.name: Gharizah
data.gender_notes: Gharizah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'gharaza', meaning 'to punish'. In Islamic tradition, Gharizah refers to the punishment or retribution inflicted upon those who commit injustices, as a means of achieving divine balance and justice. The name Gharizah carries the meaning “Punishment, Retribution” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gharizah usually hope their child will grow to embody punishment, retribution and live with faith, good character and purpose.
